name: Nemifitide
summary: Nemifitide (INN-00835) is a novel antidepressant drug with a pentapeptide structure similar to that of melanocyte-inhibiting factor (MIF-1) and the amino acid sequence 4-F-Phe-4-OH-Pro-Arg-Gly-Trp-NH2.) for the treatment of major depressive disorder.

pharmacology.text: Nemifitide (INN-00835) is a novel antidepressant drug with a pentapeptide structure similar to that of melanocyte-inhibiting factor (MIF-1) and the amino acid sequence 4-F-Phe-4-OH-Pro-Arg-Gly-Trp-NH2. The mechanism of action of nemifitide is unclear, but since MIF-1 has been demonstrated to have similar antidepressant effects it may act in an analogous manner.

uses.text: It is under development by Tetragenex (previously Innapharma, Inc.) for the treatment of major depressive disorder. It has been given to over 430 people over the course of 12 clinical trials throughout a little over the past decade and has reached Phase III studies, but has not yet been approved for marketing in any country.

fact.en: Unlike almost all antidepressants, nemifitide is a peptide, a short chain of five amino acids, modelled on a small brain peptide called MIF-1.
fact.zh: 與幾乎所有抗憂鬱藥不同，奈米非肽是一種胜肽，由五個胺基酸組成的短鏈，仿照腦中一種名為 MIF-1 的小胜肽而設計。
fact.zhHans: 与几乎所有抗忧郁药不同，纳米非肽是一种胜肽，由五个胺基酸组成的短链，仿照脑中一种名为 MIF-1 的小胜肽而设计。
